summary.text: George Whitesides is the Democratic incumbent for California's 27th Congressional District, first elected in 2024. Before Congress he was chief of staff at NASA during the Obama administration and the first CEO of Virgin Galactic, and he co-founded a nonprofit focused on wildfires and home insurance. He serves on the House Armed Services Committee and the Science, Space, and Technology Committee.

paragraphs.text: Whitesides was born in Massachusetts in 1974.
He earned a bachelor's degree in public and international affairs from Princeton University in 1996 and a master's degree in remote sensing and GIS from the University of Cambridge in 2000.
Whitesides served as chief of staff at NASA during the Obama administration, and his official biography says he received NASA's Distinguished Service Medal for his contributions.
He then became the first CEO of Virgin Galactic, which he led for about a decade; according to his official biography, the company created over 700 jobs in the Antelope Valley during that time.
He co-founded Megafire Action, a nonprofit focused on wildfire response and home insurance issues.

Locally, Whitesides co-chaired the Antelope Valley COVID-19 Task Force, work his official biography says earned NASA's Exceptional Public Achievement Medal, and served on the board of AV EDGE (Antelope Valley Economic Development and Growth Enterprise).

He was elected to the U.S. House in 2024, and in the 119th Congress he sits on the Armed Services Committee and the Science, Space, and Technology Committee, where his office describes him as Vice Ranking Member.
According to his official biography, he and his wife, Loretta Hidalgo Whitesides, have been married for nearly 20 years and have two children.
